title.narrative: Climate change and Security: Addressing Potential Instabilities in Bangladesh

description.narrative: Contract related to: Climate change and Security: Addressing Potential Instabilities in Bangladesh - This action will enable the EU to address short and medium-term foreign policy needs and opportunities by supporting innovative policies/initiatives and by deepening EU relations and dialogues, forging alliances and partnerships. In particular, this action will reinforce the EU¿s new relationship with the United Kingdom, support the achievement of the EU¿s foreign policy objectives in relation to Russia, develop engagement in Bangladesh to adapt to the threats to stability and security posed by climate change, partner with the United Nations to address the food crisis, deepen EU relations through the provision of public sector expertise.
